label: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
output:
Priya — first, stop apologizing. To me or to Greg.

I'm not throwing you under the bus, and you should hear that from me before you spiral. I've got Greg. He's going to be upset no matter what I tell him, so that conversation is mine to have, and I'm going to have it as "here's what happened and here's the fix," not "here's who to blame."

Second: this isn't really a Priya failure. Q14 came out of the questionnaire library, and that library is a mess — half stale draft answers, nobody owns it. If I'd pulled the same answer, I'd have sent the same wrong thing. One copy-paste mistake doesn't end you on this account. You've been great on Brazos.

Now, the part you actually need to know: you're not the reason I'm fighting for this deal. Brazos is 186k ARR on a three-year term, and I've been working it since February. I've also been telling my wife we're finally taking the Big Bend trip off this commission. So I have a pretty selfish stake in making sure we don't flatten the person who knows this account best over one line on a form. We fix this together, and we do it fast and honest. Dana seems strict, but strict and fair is workable — that's the kind of buyer you can win.

Plan, so you know where you're going:

1. **Q14 tonight**, with the real status: Type I issued in April, Type II audit in progress, audit window closes January 31, report expected by March. Send it to me first, not to Dana. I'll handle Dana.
2. **Thursday, 2:00** — Marcus on our security team is joining a call with Dana and their legal. You need to be on it too. You know this account better than anyone; I'd rather have you in the room than have their lawyers asking questions to an empty chair.
3. **Bridge letter** — Marcus says we can get one from the auditor to cover the gap between Type I and Type II. That's likely what unblocks legal on their end. Marcus will bring it Thursday, but I wanted you to know the shape of it now.

After Brazos closes, you and I are going to sort out who owns that questionnaire library, so nobody else eats a stale answer.

One more thing: you stayed until 9pm in September rebuilding their demo env when the route import broke, and I never said thank you. Thank you.

Now go fix Q14, and stop beating yourself up.

Jordan
